Window windows[0x2c] (0x10 each; also referenced at fixed 0x60,0x140,0x150,0x160)
flags byte: bit0 toggled via manual mask (selects window bank), bits4-6 masked separately

risks: rodata ov14_021F84B4 is a WindowTemplate[0x2c] (0x160 bytes); must emit in-order as a single static const array declared before/consumed by ov14_021F4ED0 -- rodata ordering is byte-load-bearing.

G->flags byte @0x44e is written with a manual bit0 mask (bic/and/orr, no (u8) narrow) plus separate nibble masks in ov14_021F5404/5564 -- model as union {u8 raw; struct bits} per flags-byte-union-manual-mask-bit0; a plain bitfield assign inserts a spurious (u8) narrow at bit0.

Stack-passed x/y/fontId/color/align in ov14_021F4F24/4F84/4FBC are read sp-direct with ldr (word) -> declare int/u32 not u16, else Thumb ldrh forces an extra base-pointer add (u16-stack-param-as-int-avoids-ldrh-basepointer).
In ov14_021F4F24 center-align, FontID_String_GetWidth returns u32 so width/2 emits an unsigned lsr -- keep width u32 (inverse of u32-call-return-makes-divide insight).
ov14_021F4F00 loop counter is narrowed each iter (lsl#16/lsr#16) -> u16; ov14_021F5404/5564 use full-width u16 indices with unsigned bounds (bcc/blo).

ov14_021F5404 and ov14_021F5718 have complex nested loops and multi-arg stack calls; medium/low confidence on some arg widths -- verify ov14_021F5718 a2/a3/a4 against its caller in overlay_14_021F6628.s.
ov14_021F5190 takes the OUTER work (needs SaveData); its siblings 5000/5054/50A0/5114/521C/528C/52FC take the INNER G -- do not unify the first param type across the family.

Several imports (sub_020135xx / sub_02021Axx / SpriteManager_* / FontOAM_Delete) prototypes are inferred -- confirm exact headers (likely include/unk_02013534.h) before adding declarations to avoid IPA header churn.
